snippet.title: Transfer Point: a point-and-click adventure game for Macintosh
snippet.description:
Transfer Point is a point-and-click adventure game about regret, forgiveness, and email. Coming soon for most browsers, and for download on itch.io.

Transfer Point was created in World Builder, a program for the original Macintosh released in 1986. The game was made live on Twitch from March 2023 through June 2024, with the help of many wonderful people. Together we explored World Builder’s important place in the history of adventure games and multimedia creation, and learned that anyone can still have fun making new things with old software.

💾 Learn more: https://robotspacer.software/transfer-point.html
🌐 Making of series: https://robotspacer.tv/archive/world-builder.html
⚠️ Transfer Point features themes of death and relationship struggles. Descriptions of death are included.
🏷️ #AdventureGame #PointAndClick #MARCHintosh
